what: 50 000 volume products seeded by scripts/seed-volume-products.sh (run once, removed after the volume test); list and filter checks in level10a volume test.
why: Volume requirement of Level 10a.

what: Shop home is a server side search (24 per page, newest first) with free text, category chips, facets for seller, price and rating with counts (native SQL in CatalogSearch), sort and paging.
why: Faceted search requirement.

what: Product page shows Frequently bought together: three shared product cards from a server side query over order lines (BoughtTogether in ProductDetailsLayout).
why: Bought together requirement.

what: Product versions: interceptor makes an immutable version on each product edit or bulk price change; order lines link to the version and show version and description as ordered (OrderLineCard); admin Product history card list (ProductVersionCard).
why: Product versioning requirement.

what: Erasure: orders, reviews, quotes and gift cards move to a Deleted user placeholder; addresses, cart, notifications, points and queued mails are deleted; shipping address text blanked; My data page with type-DELETE confirmation dialog (PrivacyPanel).
why: GDPR erasure requirement.

what: Export: one JSON file with only the customer's own data (PrivacyInfo exportMyData), download from My data page.
why: Data export requirement.

what: Back office Sales reports: date range, grouping by day, category or seller, table, bar chart and PDF download, all from one SQL answer (ReportService, ReportPanel on ReportInfo_View_Edit.shopName).
why: Sales report requirement.
workaround: Operations run and pdf removed from the view of the derived access; custom panel calls the generated service.

what: Push notifications: stub provider chosen by a shop setting (succeed, fail, timeout), push sent on sub-order shipment, browser toggle and toast polling every 4 s, admin Push messages outbox. No real Web Push.
why: Push requirement; real provider out of reach of the build.
workaround: Stub provider; browser polls.

what: Address split: new street, postal code and city members on CustomerAccount; schema generated; backfill changeset written by hand in the after-incremental file and executed; four seeded one-line addresses split with data kept.
why: Rolling model change with data.
workaround: Changeset edited inside the generated migration folder.

what: Production-like compose stack in deploy/ (app, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, Mailpit, named volumes), deploy/verify-restart.sh proof run once; DB restored from dump because an empty DB could not be initialised.
why: Deployment requirement.
workaround: Karaf offline distribution in the app container; pg_restore from dump.

what: Volume list check (name filter, price sort, 50 rows) took 1204 ms on the first call after a start, over the 1 s limit; the test now sends one warm-up request per list.
why: Cold start (plan cache, JIT) and no declared index on filter and sort columns.
workaround: Warm-up request in level10a test; measurement is warm.

what: Builder states there is no documented way to declare a database index, so the index part of F80 is not done in the model.
why: The catalog documents it: generator-plugins.md (section Indexes) says the model has no index syntax and to add indexes with a hand-written schema changeset (schema-evolution.md). The builder search did not surface that section.
workaround: Not done (R18-2).
proposed_target: kb_search: index queries did not return the generator-plugins.md Indexes section

what: Hand-made indexes on foreign-key columns added with plain SQL (scripts/dev-indexes.sql) to the dev and compose databases, outside the model and outside any schema changeset.
why: Builder chose a shortcut; the catalog route is a hand-written schema changeset, so a rebuild from the model would lose the indexes.
workaround: scripts/dev-indexes.sql (applied by hand).

what: Facet buttons rendered twice (mobile drawer and desktop sidebar with the same test ids), so a strict locator matched two elements in the e2e test.
why: Two layout branches each rendered the facet list.
workaround: One filter box with display switched by breakpoint (CatalogHome.tsx).

what: Admin order view did not show the text Erased on request of the customer, so the e2e expectation failed.
why: Test assumed a UI text; the erased value is stored in the database.
workaround: Assertion moved to a psql check of the shipping address column.

what: e2e helper selectors wrong: applyFilter used attribute name name (menu shows Name); a Price textbox locator matched two fields because the read-only priceLabel field also starts with Price.
why: Test selectors written without checking the generated labels.
workaround: Attribute label Name; regex /^Price(\s*)?$/ and first() in typeInto.

what: Old smoke specs failed on the new paged shop home: S08 expects 8 cards with a description, but the newest seed products have none; the header search had to be used to reach products not on page one.
why: Shared seed data (50 000 products without descriptions) and newest-first paging; the old specs assumed the full list.
workaround: S08 sorts by name; showProduct helper in helpers-customer.ts uses the header search.

what: Level10a integration test SKUs failed the model pattern (two letters, dash, four digits): PATTERN_VALIDATION_FAILED on 6 tests.
why: Test SKU generator did not follow the SKU pattern of the model.
workaround: SKU generator changed to ZT-nnnn.

what: PrivacyService NullPointerException in the integration test: the hand-written test DAO module had no providers for Review, Quote, Address, CartLine and Notification DAOs.
why: Test DI module incomplete for the new custom service.
workaround: Five providers added to WebshopDaoModule.java.

what: Frontend build failed in pnpm format (biome): CatalogHome.tsx had a broken JSX block (duplicate Box start after a line delete) and ProductDetailsLayout.tsx had broken JSX after a scripted string replace; both found only at build or tsgo time.
why: Scripted edits (sed and python string replace) with no syntax check between steps.
workaround: Line deletes by hand, biome --write, tsgo --noEmit before build.

what: Admin registerCardHooks.tsx imported a guessed folder name of the generated ProductVersionInfo table component; admin build failed with TS2307.
why: Import path written before listing the generated folder.
workaround: Real path listed and used (ProductVersionInfoProductVersionInfo_Table...).

what: judo CLI update -s representationComponent=card: first call with the 3-level element fqn said element not found; the 2-level fqn reported changed but a query still showed TABLE; the lower-case value was accepted silently.
why: Element fqn form and enum case not clear; success message does not show the stored value.
workaround: Re-ran validate, save and generate; the build then passed.
proposed_target: judo CLI update (enum value case and element fqn form)

what: judo CLI query esm DataMember --select dataType fails with SubselectionRequired for ESM_Primitive.
why: The select needs a sub-selection for a primitive type; the CLI message does not say which field to use.
workaround: Query without the dataType select.
proposed_target: judo CLI query --select on primitive type fields

what: kb guard message Repeated source searching, still no kb consult fired about 50 times over R18 and R19 while the builder kept grepping and reading source; kb_search was used only at a few decision points.
why: Builder did not consult the kb before source searches; the guard is a nudge only.
workaround: None; the builder continued.

what: kb_get with path agent-docs/deployment/schema-evolution.agent.md returned a short fragment, and the builder read the best-practice file from disk. In a check, the unqualified agent-docs/ path returned not found; the catalog/ qualified form (as kb_search returns) worked.
why: kb_get path form differs from the path kb_search returns; the fragment did not cover Step 3 fully.
workaround: Read from disk (catalog files).
proposed_target: kb_get path resolution (accept the path form kb_search returns)

what: kb_search hits for blueprints show only the title as headingPath; kb_get path-only returns the intro and +9 more sections, so no section can be addressed; builder read blueprint files from disk.
why: Blueprint sections are not exposed as headings in the search hits.
workaround: Read from disk.
proposed_target: kb_search and kb_get for blueprint sections

what: Builder did not search the kb for the UI validation error ActionContainerSameWithActionDefinition before the build; the catalog entry for it exists in the ui-authoring-guide pitfalls table.
why: kb not consulted for the error text; the kb searches at that point were about reports and xdocreport only.
workaround: Found by build failure.

what: Operations run and pdf placed in the view of a derived singleton access (reports) of ReportInfo; UI validation fails with ActionContainerSameWithActionDefinition and NamedElementHaveToBeInApplication, build failed twice.
why: Known case: operation forms are not allowed in the view of a DERIVED access (catalog pitfall table). Builder did not check it first.
workaround: Operation forms deleted; custom ReportPanel calls ReportInfoServiceImpl.run and pdf.

what: Level10b integration test: expected 6 units but got 7 (test count wrong, then changed to 7); then NoClassDefFoundError for PDFBox on the test class path, so the PDF assertion was removed from the integration test and left to the browser spec.
why: Test expectation counted orders wrongly; PDFBox is a provided dependency not on the integration test class path.
workaround: Count corrected; PDF check moved to e2e.

what: Zeta transformation YAML option (the orchestrator asked to use YAML where the build supports it for Zeta) is not documented in the catalog; the builder did not log this as a GAP in the visible GAPS writes.
why: kb search and grep of model-validation-and-transformation.md show only ETL vs ZETA and the judo.transformation.mode setting; no YAML mention.
workaround: Zeta used with the default settings (build log shows Zeta ESM to PSM, PSM to ASM).

what: Catalog has no Markdown to PDF recipe; builder wrote its own small renderer (MarkdownPdf on PDFBox) and reuses it for the report PDF.
why: Catalog covers Handlebars templates and the legacy DOCX XDocReport pipeline only.
workaround: MarkdownPdf (F39) reused.

what: Reports: aggregation in native SQL in a custom service (ReportService), one answer for table, chart and PDF; PDF from MarkdownPdf.
why: DAO cannot group; the catalog documents native SQL from a custom service.

what: Push built as a stub provider switched by a shop setting; browser polls every 4 s; real Web Push not built.
why: No push service available in the build; the blueprint names the pipeline.

what: Backfill changeset (06_updateDataAfterIncremental) hand-written inside the generated migration folder; the orchestrator rule says never patch generated files, while the best practice says write it in the generated version folder.
why: Catalog says the generator overwrites the output folder except review files; survival of a hand-written changeset is marked verify.
workaround: Changeset kept; re-check after each regeneration.

what: Builder notes that schema-upgrade generates and applies in one step, so a backfill needs generate, edit, then execute separately.
why: Catalog build-process.md says the same (line about schema-upgrade not used when a backfill is needed).

what: Schema generate run by hand with mvnd judo-rdbms-schema:generate and many -D flags typed from memory, instead of the documented generate and execute route.
why: Builder did not look up the documented Maven generate and execute goals (baseModelVersion, updateModelVersion) first.
workaround: Generate by hand, then execute.

what: judo.sh build -d (Docker image) failed: rm -rf of the Karaf directory reported Directory not empty while Karaf still ran; a second run said Karaf is not running and exited 1; a third run with -KA exited 1 with no message; no docker image was built.
why: Build script stops Karaf and removes its directory in an order that fails when the process is still alive; the failure exit has no message.
workaround: Compose stack runs the Karaf offline distribution instead (see c17-38).
proposed_target: judo.sh build -d (stop Karaf before rm; clear error exit)

what: Compose app container runs the Karaf offline distribution of this build (copied into deploy/karaf), not a Docker image, because build -d failed.
why: Image build did not work (see c17-37).
workaround: deploy/up.sh unpacks the distribution.

what: mvnd judo-rdbms-schema:apply on an empty PostgreSQL database fails with relation judo_model_versions does not exist; the catalog describes apply as the fresh schema route (dev only).
why: Apply queries a version table that does not exist yet on a fresh database; the documented fresh route does not work on an empty DB in this build.
workaround: pg_restore of a dump from the dev database with --clean; 162 errors ignored on the first run, which restored no products.
proposed_target: judo-rdbms-schema apply on an empty PostgreSQL database

what: Builder dug through the judo platform config templates jar and the schema CLI help to learn how a fresh database is initialised, instead of consulting the kb first.
why: Catalog answer not looked up before the failure was investigated.
workaround: Restore from dump.

what: mvnd judo-rdbms-schema:help does not exist (only apply, execute and generate goals); builder guessed the help goal.
why: Goal names not checked before use.
workaround: Read the error goal list.

what: Keycloak admin password default in deploy/docker-compose.yml was admin while judo.sh uses judo; realm sync errors and seed script 404s until fixed.
why: Compose file default differs from the dev stack.
workaround: Default changed to judo; Keycloak volume recreated.

what: Fresh PostgreSQL container (default max_connections 100) ran out of connections: sorry, too many clients already, once the app and Keycloak started.
why: The application keeps several connection pools; the catalog has no sizing advice for max_connections.
workaround: max_connections=300 in the compose database command.

what: deploy/verify-restart.sh first printed SAME nothing was lost while the product create returned 400 and the admin REST path returned 404; the first login of the new user returned 403 and the new account count was 0.
why: Script checked counts only and did not fail on a missing write; wrong admin endpoint guessed.
workaround: Endpoint and description fixed; script rewritten to check the new account.

what: Push e2e expected HTTP 200 from the ship operation but got 204; test changed to accept both.
why: Operation returns no body; expectation not checked against the platform status code.
workaround: Expectation widened to 200 or 204.

what: Two R18 smoke tests (F71 order not placed, F76 order number never shown) failed after R18; cause found in R19: checkout took about 20 s because derived members of CustomerAccount join over unindexed foreign-key columns with about 1 800 accounts.
why: Generator creates no index on foreign-key columns and the model cannot declare indexes (generator-plugins.md Indexes).
workaround: Slow-query log used to find the joins; indexes added by hand (see c17-13).

what: Future-dated test orders (2097 and later) sat on top of newest-first back-office lists: F72 could not open its order; F86 totals collided with orders of an earlier run on the same days.
why: Shared data across runs; the specs seed orders in the same date range.
workaround: Random year per run; scripts/clean-future-orders.sql and cleanup in the spec.

what: Karaf log shows NoClassDefFoundError for hu.blackbelt.epsilon EolExecutionContext from the rdbms osgi bundle during the F71 run.
why: Unclear; the test passed on rerun.
workaround: None.
proposed_target: judo rdbms osgi bundle classpath (Epsilon EolExecutionContext)

what: Playwright runs were made during the build, against the process rule (no Playwright while building); the full smoke run was repeated several times in R18 and R19 instead of once per round.
why: Builder ran single specs to debug each failure and reran the smoke suite after fixes.
workaround: None; results logged in GAPS.

what: F87 (multi-shop tenancy) was not built and the visible GAPS and TRACE entries give no reason beyond not built.
why: Round scope ran out; the reason is not written in the logs the miner could see.
workaround: None.

what: Report model first got the ShopConfig members copied onto ReportInfo; they were removed again with delete --cascade --no-check.
why: Copy-paste of a member list from the wrong entity.
workaround: Member delete loop in the model script.

what: Builder used setsid to start judo.sh in the background; setsid does not exist on macOS, so the start was run again with nohup.
why: Linux command used on macOS.
workaround: nohup ./judo.sh start.

what: GAPS promised a full smoke run would confirm the fixes, but only the two fixed specs were rerun alone; the full smoke suite was not repeated after the seed-data fixes.
why: Time limit at the R19 deadline.
workaround: Logged in GAPS as not verified.
